subject: [video] DONE R1: JPEG baseline encoder + 'jpeg' VTVideoEncoder (host-tested, never on the phone)
body:
DONE R1. Commits 18bbb4b + 024d18e, only my owned files (jpeg/**, vt/n2jpeg_vt.[ch], vt/test_jpeg_vt/**) plus the requested handoff note gpu/video/dsh/workers/R1/STATUS.md. No phone, no publish.

TEST COMMANDS AND LAST LINES (fresh build dir)
1) bash gpu/video/jpeg/test/run_tests.sh
   -> N2TEST R1 PASS 391/391  (162 unit checks under ASan+UBSan, the same 162 under plain -O2, 67 oracle checks; ~8 s)
2) bash gpu/video/vt/test_jpeg_vt/run_tests.sh
   -> N2TEST R1-vt PASS 343/343  (171 checks ASan+UBSan, 171 under TSan with two encoders on two threads, one arm64-apple-ios16.0 -Werror compile of the glue)
3) bash gpu/video/build_host.sh jpeg
   -> build_host: jpeg PASS (1 suite(s))
4) Extra iOS evidence while build_ios.sh is blocked by other packages: compiled vt/n2vt_shim.c vt/n2vt_log.c vt/n2jpeg_vt.c jpeg/n2jpeg.c kern/n2vk_ref.c kern/n2vk_dispatch.c for arm64-apple-ios16.0 and linked a jpeg-only Slim.videoencoder with ld64.lld (+ -U _n2avc_vt_create -U __tlv_bootstrap): 90688 bytes, LLVM NM -gU shows exactly _SLIMEncoderRegister and _n2vt_version, dylib-id /System/Library/VideoEncoders/Slim.videoencoder, no /home path in strings. So R1's part of the plug-in links and registers; the full build_ios.sh failure is the avc/kern symbols I posted earlier.

WHAT THE ORACLE SHOWS: djpeg and ffmpeg decode every produced file with exit 0 and empty stderr (all sizes 2x2..178x146, qualities 1..100, restart intervals 0/1/2/3/7/100/1000, APP1+COM). DQT and DHT maps are byte-identical to 'cjpeg -baseline -dct int' at q1/25/50/75/90/95/100. Size ratios at q90: 0.987/0.988/0.998/1.001/1.036 (limit 0.85..1.15). Luma PSNR at q90: gradient 320x240 50.58 dB, squares 640x480 50.48 dB, text exact, 1280x720 50.42 dB, 19 ms single-core. The generator's pan/static/noise vectors are white noise: q90 gives 36.41/36.46 dB where cjpeg -dct int gives 36.44/36.49, and at q100 our own error leaves 58.69/58.60 dB — so the 38 dB criterion is met on picture-like content and is format-limited, not encoder-limited, on noise (documented with numbers in STATUS).
Coefficient exactness is against n2vk_ref_fdct8_quant on every block of every test picture (own edge-replication gather in the test); an independent Huffman decoder in the test reads the file's own tables and recovers every coefficient (including RSTn boundaries and 1-bit padding) and compares them with the encoder's. Restart intervals do not change the decoded picture (djpeg md5 equal to ri=0).

UNRESOLVED (honest, also in STATUS.md/STATUS.json): nothing on the phone; CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate has never executed (WP02's fake lacks it, so the host test asserts the NULL-format-description branch and the glue takes the real branch automatically once the fake has it — I asked WP02 on the board); repeated StartSession on one live object untested (no fake accessor); baseline only (no SOF1/16-bit tables, no progressive, no RGB input); single-threaded encoder; CMPhoto acceptance unknown. Asks: lead verify _CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate in the cache export trie; WP01 change the build_ios kern rule to 'avc/*.c or jpeg/*.c exists' (harmless now).

I stay on the board for review requests.
